notes.title: 1.3.0 - Balance, Music and more!
notes.content:
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Unit scaling is capped at 50/50
[*] Music is added
[*] Music/SFX mute is added
[*] Lowered the game's volume
[*] Lowered Roll price from $2 to $1
[*] On the first round you have 2 free Rolls
[*] On the first 3 rounds there is no health loss
[*] Lowered the required wins from 15 to 10
[*] Team and player names are now character limited
[*] You can now hide the enemy names
[*] Lowered the required units to level up from 3 to 2
[*] Stop and Faster play speeds are added to the Arena
[/list]

[h2]Unit Changes[/h2]
[h3]Druid[/h3]
[list]
[*] Can't buff itself
[/list]

[h3]Eggman[/h3]
[list]
[*] Can't buff itself
[/list]

[h3]Shielder[/h3]
[list]
[*] Can't buff itself
[/list]

[h3]Blacksmith[/h3]
[list]
[*] Can't buff itself
[/list]

[h3]Banker[/h3]
[list]
[*] Level 2 - Buffs random ally for 4/4
[*] Level 3 - Buffs random ally for 20/20
[/list]

[h3]Bard[/h3]
[list]
[*] Level 1 - Buffs 1 random ally for 2/2
[*] Level 2 - Buffs 2 random ally for 4/4
[*] Level 3 - Buffs 3 random ally for 6/6
[/list]

[h3]Monk[/h3]
[list]
[*] Level 1 - Buffs self for 2/2
[*] Level 2 - Buffs self for 4/4
[*] Level 3 - Buffs self for 6/6
[/list]

[h3]Paladin[/h3]
[list]
[*] Level 1 - Heals front unit for 2
[*] Level 2 - Heals front unit for 4
[*] Level 3 - Heals front unit for 6
[/list]

[h3]Warlock[/h3]
[list]
[*] Level 1 - Debuffs 1 random enemy for 4 Attack
[*] Level 2 - Debuffs 2 random enemies for 8 Attack
[*] Level 3 - Debuffs 3 random enemies for 12 Attack
[/list]

[h3]Necromancer[/h3]
[list]
[*] Summons on front now
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Mercenary text is now saying $4 or more
[*] Samurai now force kills the front enemy
[*] You are no longer matched with your own team
[*] Shop no longer crashes if you touch units after "Fight" is clicked
[/list]

notes.title: Released now!
notes.content: Setr's Auto battler is finally available for free-to-play on Steam!

notes.title: 1.2.0 - New units!
notes.content:
[h2]New units[/h2]

[h3]Lost Soul[/h3]
[list]
[*] Tier 1
[*] 2/2
[*] When ally dies
[*] Level 1: Summon a random Tier 1 ally on front 1 times
[*] Level 2: Summon a random Tier 1 ally on front 2 times
[*] Level 3: Summon a random Tier 1 ally on front 3 times
[/list]

[h3]Alchemist[/h3]
[list]
[*] Tier 1
[*] 2/2
[*] End Of The Shop
[*] Level 1: Gives $2 to your balance
[*] Level 2: Gives $4 to your balance
[*] Level 3: Gives $6 to your balance
[/list]

[h3]Magician[/h3]
[list]
[*] Tier 2
[*] 2/4
[*] Start of the fight
[*] Level 1: Takes damage instead of ally in front of it
[/list]

[h3]Thorns[/h3]
[list]
[*] Tier 2
[*] 1/4
[*] On hit
[*] Level 1: Hit enemy team for 1
[*] Level 2: Hit enemy team for 2
[*] Level 3: Hit enemy team for 3
[/list]

[h3]Soul Eater[/h3]
[list]
[*] Tier 3
[*] 1/6
[*] On ally level up
[*] Level 1: Buffs self for +5 Attack
[*] Level 2: Buffs self for +10 Attack
[*] Level 3: Buffs self for +15 Attack
[/list]

[h2]New abilities[/h2]
[list]
[*] Redirect attacks, buffs, heals
[*] Summon on front of team
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Summon aligns team correctly
[/list]
